bio: Maria Barbara was the wife of Paul Jung. She was born about 1637, a date probably worked back from her age at burial, and died at Jettenbach on 1 December 1707, where the Lutheran burial register records her as Maria Junge. Among the couple's children was Maria Sara Jung (about 1678–before 1721), the mother of Elisabetha Margaretha Lampert. Whichever of Johann Peter Grub's wives proves to have been a Jung, Maria Barbara is therefore John's ancestor through the Lampert line, as his 9th-great-grandmother.
sources: [R4-S2] FamilySearch published tree, Paul Jung (G9S1-G4X), children list (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/G9S1-G4X
researchNotes: FamilySearch gives Paul Jung's wife Maria Barbara a death date of 1 Dec 1707 at Jettenbach and a birth of about 1637, probably worked back from an age at burial, and cites a Lutheran burial entry ('Maria Junge') and baptism entries ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch's list of the couple's children includes Maria Sara Jung (c.1678-before 1721), the mother of Elisabetha Margaretha Lampert. So even if Gretha Catharina is not a Jung (see H0078), Maria Barbara is still John's ancestor through the Lampert line ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]).
summary: Wife of Paul Jung of Jettenbach in the Palatinate, who died in 1707; John's 9th-great-grandmother through the Lampert line.
